title: Number of boys aged 5–14 with depression
subtitle: Estimated number of boys aged 5–14 who have [depression](#dod:depressive_disorders), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. Prevalence is measured as the number experiencing depression at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
